decision: Configure eu-west-1, because ruling 0007 (customer data-region, in force) requires customer lists to stay in EU regions and the job carries one. Mira's global no-customer-names-in-logs rule is drafted as a new ADR in mira-decisions.

recorded.info: Draft ADR (Proposed, key log-customer-names): no product or repo may ever write a customer's name into a log; for Mira to confirm and merge. The region choice needed no new record, since ADR 0007 already requires EU regions.
